title: Get your tyres ready for winter
summary: Colder, wetter roads ask more of your tyres. Check tread, pressure and condition before the weather turns.
image_alt: Illustration of a tyre and wheel
author: The Kestrel Garage team

body.p: Grip matters most when the roads are cold and wet. A quick check now can save a puncture on a dark evening.
The legal minimum for cars is 1.6mm across the central three quarters of the tread, all the way round. Many drivers choose to replace tyres well before that point.

ul: Check pressures when the tyres are cold, using the figures in your handbook or door pillar.
Look for cuts, cracks and bulges in the sidewalls.
Do not forget the spare if your car has one.
